report.headline: Five new construction sites near the Katy, Cypress and Richmond areas you serve.
report.supportingCopy: Each site comes from a TCEQ construction stormwater record, picked for your 15- and 20-yard roll-offs and read for hauling scope and a real contact.
report.reportIdentifier: SAMPLE REPORT FOR RENEGADE ROLL-OFFS LLC
report.territory: Katy, Cypress and Richmond service areas

projects.name: Fifth Third Bank Shops at Katy
projects.whatsFiled: Construction stormwater authorization for the Katy address above, operator on file The Fifth Third Bank. The record lists no project type.
projects.likelyScope: Roll-off containers, 15 to 20 yard, for construction debris on a commercial build; our read from the site name, not the filing.
projects.whoDecides: Operator on file is The Fifth Third Bank, a routing contact, not confirmed as the hauling decision-maker. No hauler is named in the record, which is not the same as no hauler chosen.
projects.contactLine: Operator on file: The Fifth Third Bank (business name from the TCEQ record)
projects.firstStep: Call the operator's main office and ask who books site services for this job.

pilot.headline: How this list was built.
bullets: Five sites pulled from TCEQ construction stormwater records, each with its own authorization number, each checked ACTIVE on October 30.
Distances and hauling scope are our read of the public record, not confirmation that work has started or that a hauler is unselected.
No individual names; every contact is a business name on file.
pilot.disclosure: A stormwater authorization shows a site is permitted for construction; it does not say who hauls for it.
